secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (Settings → API). Optional — demo mode works without it.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon public key (Settings → API). Optional — demo mode works without it.

secrets.name: VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN
secrets.description: Mapbox access token for map features (account.mapbox.com). Optional.

secrets.name: VITE_RAZORPAY_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Razorpay public key ID for payments (dashboard → API Keys). Optional.

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase web API key for FCM push (Firebase Console → Project Settings). Optional.
